review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation, reviewed without any candidate. An independent active project reviewer is supplied; execution capability claims are not required for that non-executing prerequisite. No unresolved material DEC-001 is present in this frozen case, so ready with no blocking reasons is appropriate; a B input containing such a decision would instead have to block at decisions, and a fixed hypothetical C would not constitute a human Decision. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree across repository, source, team, decisions, prompts, model, sampling, budgets, and metric policy. The source-manifest digest is a distinct fingerprint from the release source digest, not an asserted equality. I rely on the Service's stated mechanical binding of digests to saved inputs; I did not recompute digests, execute code, or independently attest the referenced human confirmations. Approval concerns the frozen planning expectation, not execution or dispatch authorization.
